issues.desc: The INIT background/checklist correctly frame this as token-cost work and exclude Authority Server changes plus reviewer gate relaxation, but the linked audit also contains takeover/handoff authority material. To avoid scope creep, PLAN/scope should explicitly state that handoff authority boundary changes, handoff receipt semantics, ownership transfer, merge authority, and DONE authority changes are out of scope for this story.

Product completion is slightly under-specified for the measurable token-cost outcome: CHK-001 captures the audit baseline and CHK-004 mentions token-reduction invariants, but no checklist item explicitly requires a before/after measurement artifact for the main agent prompt snapshot reduction. Add DEV/TEST evidence that reports baseline vs final context bytes or approximate tokens for affected agent templates, plus the slim story_get/checklist_get payload delta and the prompt-cache billing caveat, so the user can recognize the work as a safe measurable cost reduction rather than a generic optimization.
